ch01_shadow_directions.name: Two shadow directions
ch01_shadow_directions.description: Shadows in the anniversary print fall in two different directions, so two light sources were used.

ch01_snowbank_depth.name: Snowbank depth mismatch
ch01_snowbank_depth.description: The snowbank in the photo does not match the drift recorded that night, so the location was built.

ch01_logo_patch.name: Knitwear logo in cloned patch
ch01_logo_patch.description: A knitwear brand logo founded in 1998 sits inside a cloned patch, so the print was retouched recently.

ch01_anniversary_leaflet.name: 2016 anniversary leaflet
ch01_anniversary_leaflet.description: A leaflet for the 20th anniversary, found in Katherine's flat. It reprints the rescue photo, and the frame has no knitwear logo.
